answer_1.quote: we focus on end-to-end TOD systems... they generate agent responses based on the dialog history and task-specific knowledge.

answer_2.quote: For evaluating model performance, we use the Entity F1 and BLEU metrics prevalent in the end-to-end TOD paradigm.

answer_4.quote: We had two annotators evaluate responses from Gold, MAKER, , and Sync-TOD (GPT-4) models. They assessed the responses for a) appropriateness to the dialog history and KB, b) fluency and c) consistency on a 1-5 Likert Scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each system response on appropriateness, fluency, and consistency using a 1-5 Likert scale.
